sections.title: Prerequisite Intuition: The Fourier Perspective

Time domain shows when signals occur.

sections.title: The Mathematical Bound
lecture_lines: Signal product has a minimum floor.
We cannot shrink both windows simultaneously.
animations: Display inequality symbol ≥ in light cyan #E0FFFF.

Fade in formula Δt * Δf ≥ 1/4π in white #FFFFFF with the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/stopwatch.svg] for Δt and [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/tuningfork.svg] for Δf.
Flash the product Δt * Δf to emphasize bound.
